full_prompt_en: A square neoclassical realist oil portrait shows a middle-aged painter seated at a drawing board in a dark studio, turning from his work to face the viewer. The man occupies the center-left, his upright torso wrapped in a nearly black brown coat. Thick curly gray-brown hair rises around his head and catches a few silver highlights against the deep background. His face is carefully modeled in warm ivory and muted rose, with a straight direct gaze and a reserved expression. A high white neckcloth and shirt collar frame his jaw, their folded fabric bright against the dark lapels. His right arm extends diagonally across the lower half toward a pale board on the right, and his hand holds a slender drawing tool above the surface. On the board, delicate gray marks and partial outlines are visible but do not form readable writing. A small tray or cluster of drawing materials sits behind his hand near the middle-right. At the far left, the edge of another framed or stretched surface leans into the scene, its warm wooden border partly lit. At the far right, the upright side of a larger canvas or easel forms a narrow vertical line. The studio itself recedes into black-brown shadow, with no detailed walls to compete with the seated figure. A controlled warm light from the upper left illuminates the face, white collar, hand, and paper, then falls away across the dark coat and surrounding space. Edges are crispest at the illuminated face and tools, softer where clothing merges with the ground. Smooth flesh modeling contrasts with fine folded fabric and restrained brushwork in the shadowed background. The overall composition balances the painter's watchful gaze with the diagonal path from shoulder to active hand, placing intellectual stillness and manual work within a concentrated pool of light.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形新古典主义写实油画肖像描绘一位中年画家坐在暗色画室的画板前，从工作中转身望向观者。男子占据中央偏左，直立的上身裹在近黑棕色外套里。浓密灰棕卷发围住头部，在深色背景前接住几处银色高光。面容以暖象牙白和低调玫瑰色细致塑造，目光直接，神情克制。高高的白色领巾和衬衣领口框住下颌，折叠的布料在深色翻领前发亮。右臂沿斜线横过下半幅伸向右侧浅色画板，手持细长绘图工具悬在表面上方。画板上有纤细灰色痕迹和局部轮廓，却不构成可读文字。手后方中右部有一个小托盘或一组绘图材料。最左边，另一块装框或绷好的画面边缘斜靠进场景，暖色木框受到局部照明。最右边，一张更大的画布或画架的竖边形成狭窄直线。画室本身退入黑棕阴影，没有细致墙面与坐姿人物争夺视线。受控暖光从左上照亮面容、白领、手和纸面，随后在深色外衣与周围空间中逐渐消退。边缘在受光的脸和工具处最清楚，衣物融入背景处更柔。平滑肌肤塑形对照精细褶布和暗背景里的克制笔触。整体构图以画家的警觉目光平衡肩到工作之手的斜线路径，把静思与手工劳作置于一片集中的光中。
style_prompt_en: The painting has a restrained neoclassical oil finish, joining precise anatomical modeling to quiet dark space. Warm ivory and subdued rose highlights rise from deep umber and charcoal, while narrow pale accents establish the visual route. Focal edges around the brightest planes are clean and controlled; outer forms taper into soft, nearly lost boundaries. Smooth tonal transitions give solid volume, and small linear details remain selective rather than spreading over the whole image. A single warm upper-side light reveals raised surfaces and hands while leaving broad background darkness undisturbed. The composition anchors one substantial dark mass beside a lighter diagonal plane, with generous negative space above. The overall effect is dignified, contemplative, and quietly dramatic.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有克制的新古典主义油画完成面，把精确的形体塑造与安静暗空间结合。暖象牙白和低调玫瑰色亮部从深棕与炭黑中浮现，狭窄浅色强调建立视觉路径。焦点明亮平面周围的边缘干净而受控，外围形体则逐渐融入柔软、几乎消失的边界。平滑明暗过渡赋予坚实体积，小的线性细节有选择地出现，而非铺满全画。单一暖色上侧方光显露凸起表面与手部，让大片背景黑暗保持完整。构图把一片有分量的深色块放在较浅的斜向平面旁，上方留有充足负空间。整体效果庄重、沉思而安静地富于戏剧性。
theme_en: A seated painter at a drawing board in a dark studio
theme_zh: 暗色画室里坐在画板前的画家
name: Jacques-Louis David
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
